Control objective: Processing limited to specific, legitimate purposes with a valid legal basis
Collection and processing limited to what is necessary
Re-identification risk reduced to an accepted level
Technical measures chosen by risk and proportional to it
Accountability for training data across versions
Residual leakage of the trained model measured
Transparency and review of automated decisions
Confidentiality of data and model in operation
Risk assessment kept current over the lifecycle
Data subject rights and storage limitation upheld
